'''Klaatu''' was one of several [[Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] who served [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. He was [[Barada/Legends|Barada's]] main assistant, in charge of repairing the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|skiffs]].<ref name="CCG" />

Klaatu was noted as a [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]], and would try his best to make his way to Jabba's throne room to view executions by [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]].<ref name="CCG" />

During the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], he was present on the top deck of the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']].<ref name="SWI67">{{InsiderCite|67|Set Piece|Set Piece: Jabba's Sail Barge}}</ref>

==Biography==
[[File:Redpantshuman.jpg|thumb|left|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] defends himself from Klaatu and another guard.]]
Klaatu was essentially an indentured servant at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], working off a large gambling debt to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], but the Nikto was secretly plotting to kill Jabba. During the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], Klaatu was on the deck of [[Khetanna/Legends|Jabba's sail barge]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] reached the place. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] approached Klaatu and cut the Nikto's weapon in half, and then Klaatu fled to the inside of the sail barge with another guard, dying in the explosion that followed.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Green Nikto seen in Jabba's palace was called Klaatu, though Wooof was one of the production names used for this character.|Leland Chee|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|holocron|29/comments|Mistaken Identities}}</ref>}}
[[File:Vul-tazaene.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Klaatu follows Jabba's entourage.]]
Klaatu was portrayed by [[Corey Dee Williams]], the son of actor [[Billy Dee Williams]].<ref name="I Survived the Sarlacc!">{{InsiderCite|143|I Survived the Sarlacc!}}</ref> Klaatu was named for [[Wikipedia:Klaatu barada nikto|''Klaatu barada nikto'']], a phrase from the 1951 film [[Wikipedia:The Day The Earth Stood Still|''The Day The Earth Stood Still'']]. "Klaatu" is the name of the humanoid alien protagonist in the film.<ref name="DB-Nikto">{{DB|species|nikto|Nikto}}</ref>

According to [[Leland Chee]], Klaatu was the [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] in the throne room, but he had already been named [[Wooof/Legends|Wooof]] (an original production name) by [[Decipher]]. However, on [[July 6]], [[2011]], Chee admitted that to be a mistake in his Keeper of the Holocron blog on Facebook, and that Wooof and Klaatu were separate characters.<ref name="KOTC">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=232130050141262&id=793375187#!/permalink.php?story_fbid=231138123573788&id=1152097426|nobackup=1}}</ref>

On-set production photos[http://nl.starwars.wikia.com/wiki/Bestand:Tanus_Wooof_Geezum_Klaatu.jpg] of Jabba's throne room revealed however, that both [[Wooof/Legends|Wooof]] and Klaatu were present during the throne room scenes. While mostly left out-of-frame during the Palace scenes, he can be spotted over the shoulder of a character he's standing behind, next to [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]].

The "Klaatu (Palace)" action figure made by Kenner in 1983 was based on Wooof. However, in the same year Kenner also produced a "Klaatu (in Skiff Guard Outfit)" action figure which was based on the actual Klaatu. The two characters are in fact different. Hasbro's 1999 "Klaatu" figure included in the Jabba's Skiff Guards set was also based on Klaatu.

In the [[Dark Horse Comics]] issue [[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]], a group of individuals is said to include "Klaatu,"<ref name="TOTJ">[[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]]</ref> potentially a misidentification of the Kadas'sa'Nikto [[Species/Legends|species]].

Klaatu was given an entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which showed him as the character previously erroneously identified as [[Yotts Orren]] on the ''Khetanna''.
